title: Welcome / Table Frame
purpose: Establish tone, expectations, and the table's shared social contract.
player_facing: Welcome to a beginner-friendly Daggerheart one-shot in Peril to Profit’s Goldspire Territories. We’ll learn by playing, build a party together, and start with a delivery job that becomes more complicated than advertised.
gm_notes: Keep it warm, confident, and short.
This is a paid public table: clarity and consent matter.

title: CATS / Campaign Calibration
purpose: Clarify concept, aim, tone, and subject matter.
concept: Corporate-fantasy delivery incident in the Goldspire Territories.
aim: Learn Daggerheart, protect a community, and discover what the sealed delivery means.
tone: 70% sincere fantasy, 20% corporate satire, 10% dark whimsy.

title: Safety Tools / Table Agreement
purpose: Establish safety tools and participation norms.
player_facing: You can pause, pass, redirect, fade to black, or step away without explaining why.

title: Daggerheart Rules Snapshot
purpose: Teach the minimum rules needed to begin.

title: Character Selection / Customization
purpose: Choose pregens, tweak pregens, or plan custom PCs.
required_decision: Marlowe PC / Marlowe NPC / Replacement Keystone Asset Custodian

title: Character Introductions
purpose: Let each player introduce who they are playing.
prompts: Why did you take this job?
What do you think of corporate authority?
What do you do when nervous?

title: What PCs Know / Don't Know
purpose: Align starting knowledge and hidden information.

title: Launch Checklist / Cut to Prologue
purpose: Confirm readiness and transition into The Contract.
